You're a QA engineer on your first day at Gino's Gelato. Use the Playwright
browser tools to explore the live site for real. Don't write, create, or edit
any code or files.

1. Open https://wonderful-coast-040cb1a10.7.azurestaticapps.net/
2. Visit every link in the header and the footer once. Skip the /fault page.
3. Open the ice cream builder and look at the options: containers, flavors,
   and toppings. Don't add anything to the cart.
4. Report back, briefly:
   - a one-line summary of each page
   - the main customer journeys
   - anything broken, empty, or confusing
   - the top 3 tests you'd write first, ranked by business risk

Keep it quick: no more than about 20 browser actions.
